dimension_leads.publisher: FVD Brombacher, seller of the replacement item

dimension_leads.meaning: commercial product envelope; measurement method and tolerances not supplied

dimension_leads.publisher: FVD Brombacher, seller of replacement bezels
dimension_leads.item: nominal bezel diameters in product titles; separate product bounding-box dimensions are larger

dimension_leads.publisher: MiniTools, maker of the replacement gauge faces
dimension_leads.item: replacement face discs, some with market-specific graphics
dimension_leads.meaning: face diameters, distinct from bezel nominal diameters and dashboard apertures
